verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents deploying custom fine-tuned models to dedicated endpoints. Users upload their weights from S3, with version tracking. Nothing in the evidence shows Cerebras running the fine-tuning job itself on the user's data, so training happens elsewhere and only the serving half of the story is delivered on-platform. Missing for 10: first-party fine-tuning/training on user data, a documented list of supported base models for tuning, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the fine-tune-to-serve workflow.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can fine-tune a supported base model on my own data and serve the result on the same platform

citations.quote: Deploy your custom fine-tuned models alongside standard model variants.
Upload fine-tuned models from your S3 bucket, track multiple versions, and deploy them to your [dedicated endpoint](/dedicated/overview).
